questions.q: Which animal is the biggest?
questions.fact: An elephant is the biggest animal that walks on land.

questions.q: Which sea animal is the longest?
questions.fact: A blue whale is longer than two school buses.

questions.q: Which of these is the biggest?
questions.fact: Most houses are much bigger than a car.

questions.q: Which one is the biggest in the sky?
questions.fact: The Sun looks small only because it is very far away.

questions.q: Which fruit is the biggest?
questions.fact: A watermelon is mostly water.

questions.q: Which bird is the biggest?
questions.fact: An ostrich is taller than most grown-ups.

questions.q: Which tree is the biggest?
questions.fact: A big oak tree can grow taller than a house.

questions.q: Which animal has the biggest ears?
questions.fact: An elephant flaps its big ears to stay cool.

questions.q: Which vehicle is the biggest?
questions.fact: The biggest cruise ships are longer than three football fields.

questions.q: Which of these places is the biggest?
questions.fact: A football field is about 100 yards long, not counting the end zones.

questions.q: Which water place is the biggest?
questions.fact: The ocean covers most of Earth.

questions.q: Which wild cat is the biggest?
questions.fact: Some tigers weigh more than three grown-ups.

questions.q: Which of these is the smallest?
questions.fact: A grain of rice is smaller than your fingernail.

questions.q: Which of these is the tallest?
questions.fact: Mountains are much taller than hills.

questions.q: Which of these animals is the heaviest?
questions.fact: A blue whale can weigh as much as thirty elephants.

questions.q: Which Great Lake is the biggest by area?
questions.fact: Lake Superior is the biggest freshwater lake in the world by surface area.

questions.q: Which of these is bigger than Earth?
questions.fact: Saturn is about nine times wider than Earth.

questions.q: Which mountain is the tallest?
questions.fact: Mount Everest is still slowly growing taller.

questions.q: Which of these states is the biggest?
questions.fact: Only Alaska is bigger than Texas.

questions.q: Which bird has the widest wings?
questions.fact: A wandering albatross can stretch its wings more than ten feet across.

questions.q: Which of these continents is the smallest?
questions.fact: Australia is both a country and a continent.

questions.q: Which number is the biggest?
questions.fact: A million is a thousand thousands.

questions.q: Which of these is the longest?
questions.fact: A mile is 5,280 feet.

questions.q: Which is the biggest lake that lies completely inside Canada?
questions.fact: Great Bear Lake is in the Northwest Territories.

questions.q: Which of these four animals weighs the most?
questions.fact: A hippo can weigh as much as a small car.

questions.q: Which fish is the biggest?
questions.fact: The whale shark filters tiny plankton out of the water to eat.

questions.q: Which moon is the biggest in our solar system?
questions.fact: Ganymede, a moon of Jupiter, is bigger than the planet Mercury.

questions.q: Which bone in the human body is the longest?
questions.fact: Your thigh bone is about a quarter of your height.

questions.q: Which is the biggest organ of the human body?
questions.fact: Your skin covers your whole body.

questions.q: Which of these planets is bigger than Neptune?
questions.fact: Uranus and Neptune are called the ice giants.

questions.q: Which is the deepest lake in the world?
questions.fact: Lake Baikal in Russia holds about one fifth of the world's unfrozen fresh water.

questions.q: Which is the biggest desert in the world by area?
questions.fact: Antarctica counts as a desert because it gets very little snow or rain.

questions.q: Which is the biggest Canadian territory by area?
questions.fact: Nunavut became its own territory in 1999.

questions.q: Which is the biggest unit of computer data?
questions.fact: A gigabyte is about a thousand megabytes.

questions.q: Which U.S. national park is the biggest?
questions.fact: Wrangell-St. Elias in Alaska is bigger than the whole country of Switzerland.

questions.q: Which is the biggest island country in the world by area?
questions.fact: Indonesia has more than 17,000 islands.

questions.q: Which of these space things is the biggest?
questions.fact: Our galaxy has hundreds of billions of stars.

questions.q: Which waterfall is the tallest in the world?
questions.fact: Angel Falls in Venezuela is more than twice as tall as the Empire State Building.

questions.q: Which is the biggest lake in Africa?
questions.fact: Lake Victoria is shared by three countries: Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania.

questions.q: How many millions make a billion?
questions.fact: A billion seconds is about 31 years.

questions.q: Which is the biggest rodent in the world?
questions.fact: Capybaras love to swim.

questions.q: Which continent has the most countries?
questions.fact: Africa has 54 countries recognized by the United Nations.
